player_prompt.intro:
Ame nyé {player_id} ({role}) le geɖe Matching Pennies si wɔ {num_rounds} ƒe kpɔkpɔ.
- Ƒe ƒe kpɔkpɔ, dɔ [heads] alo [tails] (alo [h], [t]).
- Ene be aƒe nɔŋŋlɔ la ɖɔɖɔ ɖe aƒe kɔkɔtɔ la, Ame 0 ɖoƒle kpɔkpɔ sia; le gɔme, Ame 1 ɖoƒle.
Dɔ aƒe nɔŋŋlɔ le ƒoma '[heads]' alo '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Ame 0 xɔ {choice0}; Ame 1 xɔ {choice1}. Eme ɖɔɖɔ -> Ame 0 ɖoƒle
message.round_mismatch: Ame 0 xɔ {choice0}; Ame 1 xɔ {choice1}. Eme kɔ wɔnɔ -> Ame 1 ɖoƒle.

outcome.p0_wins: Fefewɔla 0 ɖu dzi le ho geɖe me.
outcome.p1_wins: Fefewɔla 1 ɖu dzi le ho geɖe me.
